audience: MarketTime Rep Groups and Manufacturers with an Elite subscription and Public API access

useCases.title: Find wholesale orders
useCases.text: Search orders by customer, purchase order number or dates and inspect their line details.

useCases.title: Review a customer account
useCases.text: Find a customer and inspect its contacts and ship-to locations.

useCases.title: Check catalog inventory and pricing
useCases.text: Find items in the catalog, then review available inventory and pricing.

useCases.title: Record shipment tracking
useCases.text: Inspect an order and its existing shipments, then record a shipment with tracking when requested. This write is available to Manufacturer accounts.

useCases.title: Create a requested customer
useCases.text: Check for an existing customer before creating a new customer record with the supplied name, email and phone.
